text_block_list.text:
“—The Fan Appreciation Festival is coming 
up soon. It's a regular event where fans 
are invited to Tracen Academy, but...”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwa-ha-ha! Trainer, I have already decided 
on what attraction I shall put on!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"A period drama, I say! A period drama! 
Let us put on a Sengoku-era drama starring 
yours truly!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"And that is why, Trainer. You shall write 
the script."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Do not "huh" me! I simply want to look 
cool, flashy, and sharp to stand out!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, you can bring out the 
absolute best flavor in me, right? Right? 
Right?!

And so, after countless stage rehearsals— 
it was finally time for the real show.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What kind of play is it, Dantsu-chan?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm very curious! About what kind of 
role No Reason-senpai will play.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear ye! I am the Shogun, ever 
driven by my own whims...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I am the “Shogun of No Reason”~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: General Without-a-Cause...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like something pretty crazy just 
showed up...

"The script I prepared was a thrilling 
period drama where the shogun, acting just 
like No Reason, goes completely wild."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My Lord. Why did you save a mere town girl 
like me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, when it comes to helping those in 
need—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: There is no reason!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“There is no reason”... Is that her 
catchphrase?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think so. I mean, that's what they're 
saying.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I see through it!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! You dodged a strike from the 
Kongo Yae-gaki Style's Still Water Sword?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
How did you dodge that?! How did you avoid 
it?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Heh, even if you ask me how...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: There is no reason!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Eeeh... No way...?!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, let's hear it then, Mr. 
General.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Got any proof we were up to no good in 
this mansion? Gonna punish us without any, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmph, to punish you—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: There is no reason!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—!? What's the deal with this shogun 
lady!? She's totally out of control!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Silence, silence! Divine retribution for 
no particular reaaason!!

It was less of a period drama now and 
practically a comedy skit. And as for the 
audience's reaction...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of absurd historical drama is 
this...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's No Reason for you... Be it on the 
turf or on stage, there's no predicting 
what she'll do...

"It was reasonably well-received. However, 
it seemed some fans just couldn't keep up 
with the B-movie vibe."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that was utterly thrilling, Trainer! 
That was quite an entertaining script!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha, No Reason! Way to go, way to 
goー!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Encore! Encore!

“—Due to overwhelming popularity!! Many 
are calling for a further sequel—”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha! Very well! Then we shall make 
haste to confront our greatest rival!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No Reason-san, why challenge me to a race?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh, silence, Supreme Commander of Japan! 
To target you—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: There is no reason!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Don't get cocky!
(WAAAH!!)

The impromptu drama between the two star 
performers brought the house down with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that was utterly thrilling, Trainer! 
That was quite an entertaining script!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, shall I do 
another 'no reason' series next year? 
Let's see, aside from period dramas...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Like “Chief Justice of No Reason” or 
“Scientist of No Reason.”

It almost turned into a farce even crazier 
than General Without-a-Cause, but let's 
save thinking about that for next year.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, No Reason-chan. That was quite 
entertaining, truly~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Right! We wanted to be in it too, even 
just as extras.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right~. If there's a role even I could 
handle...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe a low-ranking samurai or 
something...? I've played one a bit 
before.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A low-ranking samurai, huh? Heh, 
hehehehe...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Small, too small! That's far too 
small-minded, Mirako!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh... What do you mean, small...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Such modesty will not do. For you are—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
For moving forward, the two of you will 
stand at the center of an era together 
with me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: At the center... of the era...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The roles you shall play are the 
grand leads! And the stage is not the Fan 
Appreciation Festival, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: The stage where I once shone brightly...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The tides of time shall turn once 
more. We shall stage a roaring comeback!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, before the Takarazuka Kinen, 
it might be nice for the three of us to 
run in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Anyhow! Here we go, the three of us, 
heading straight for the Takarazuka Kinen! 
And then—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, we shall turn this era 
completely on its head!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tearing up the entire era... by its 
roots...? Th-that's quite the thing to 
say...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
With my current losing streak, a GⅠ might 
be tough for me right now, but still...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to think positively! And see just 
how far I can go.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if we're going to do one, the Tenno 
Sho (Spring) would be a better fit 
distance-wise, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if everyone else is entering, 
maybe I'll join in too.”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Trainer, I leave the strategy to 
you. See to it as you see fit!

And so, the three united. Goaded on by No 
Reason, the other two gradually grew 
bolder as well.
